title: Head Of Global Partnerships em santana do matos (RN)
description:
Descrição da vaga

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Partner Management Manager to lead strategic partnerships and drive sustainable business growth. This role requires a strong commercial mindset, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and proven experience navigating complex and long sales cycles with senior decision-makers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing high-impact partnerships while owning the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and deal structuring through implementation, growth, and long-term relationship management. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and senior leadership teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership Development Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth objectives. Build and maintain strong relationships with key external stakeholders, including C-level executives and senior decision-makers. Develop partnership strategies that create long-term commercial value and competitive advantage. Conduct market analysis to identify emerging trends, white spaces, and new business opportunities.
  • Commercial Negotiation & Deal Management Lead complex commercial negotiations involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and sophisticated deal structures. Own the end-to-end partnership process, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to contract execution and post-launch growth. Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, pricing models, revenue-sharing frameworks, and strategic collaboration terms. Manage contract renewals, renegotiations, and expansion opportunities to maximize partner lifetime value. Drive alignment among internal and external stakeholders throughout the negotiation process.
  • Partner Growth & Account Management Develop strategic account plans for key partners to drive revenue growth and deepen relationships. Monitor partnership performance through KPIs, business reviews, and growth initiatives. Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing partnerships. Conduct regular business reviews with partners to ensure alignment, performance, and long-term success.

Qualifications

  • Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Key Account Management, or Enterprise Sales.
  • Proven track record of managing complex sales and negotiation cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating high-value commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong experience managing executive-level relationships.
  • Excellent analytical and commercial acumen.

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Sales Development Manager em campina grande (PB)
description:
GUT is an award-winning global creative network powered by Globant. We bring together creativity, technology, and AI to shape the future of marketing, partnering with leading global brands to create ideas that move people and drive business growth. With a diverse and passionate team across multiple countries, we're redefining how creativity and innovation work together to transform the industry, one brave idea at a time. We are looking for a Sales Development Manager to join our team in Brazil and drive new business development within the Commerce / e-commerce ecosystem. This is a strategic and highly client-facing role for a senior sales professional who understands enterprise organizations, can identify and develop new business opportunities, build strong relationships with decision-makers, and create a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sales development strategies to identify and engage new business opportunities within the Commerce and e-commerce ecosystem.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities across large companies and enterprise clients.
  • Identify target accounts, key decision-makers, business challenges, and opportunities for digital and Commerce solutions.
  • Lead prospecting and outreach initiatives across multiple channels, developing relationships with senior stakeholders and potential clients.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand client needs and identify opportunities aligned with GUT and Globant's capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with commercial, strategy, technology, marketing, and delivery teams to develop compelling value propositions and support the sales cycle.
  • Track pipeline activity, sales development metrics, forecasts, and conversion rates to ensure consistent business growth.
  • Stay informed about market trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities within Commerce, e-commerce, retail, and digital transformation.
  • Support the transition of qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales and account teams, ensuring a smooth handoff and strong commercial follow-up.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, Sales, Account Management, or related commercial roles.
  • Proven experience working with large companies / enterprise clients and engaging senior-level decision-makers.
  • Strong experience in Commerce, e-commerce, digital commerce, retail, or technology.
  • Demonstrated success in prospecting, pipeline generation, lead qualification, and new business development.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles and consultative selling methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify business opportunities and translate client needs into potential solutions.
  • Experience working in technology, digital agencies, consulting, retail, or Commerce environments is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese – mandatory.
  • Based in or preferably located in São Paulo, Brazil.

Location: Brazil | São Paulo preferred | Hybrid Model GUT is a business unit within Globant, operating as its creative and marketing division. All services are provided within the framework of Globant's corporate governance, policies, and legal entities, as applicable in each jurisdiction.

Gerente de Concessionária – Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Concessionária – para assumir a gestão estratégica e comercial da operação, liderando a equipe de vendas e garantindo a execução dos processos e diretrizes da Stellantis. Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e acompanhar a equipe comercial, estabelecendo metas e direcionando ações para o alcance dos resultados
  • Implementar e garantir a continuidade dos processos de Vendas Stellantis na concessionária
  • Gerenciar informações relacionadas a vendas realizadas, avaliações convertidas, vendas perdidas, visitas, fechamento de negócios e fluxo do showroom
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar leads provenientes da Stellantis, site da concessionária, redes sociais e demais canais
  • Monitorar agenda de clientes, oportunidades comerciais e desempenho da equipe
  • Analisar indicadores comerciais e financeiros para apoiar a tomada de decisão
  • Acompanhar volume de vendas, conversão, rentabilidade, Market Share, NPS e demais indicadores de performance
  • Desenvolver planos de ação diante de resultados abaixo das metas estabelecidas
  • Atuar em sinergia com as áreas de CRM, Marketing e Pós-Vendas
  • Atuar como elo entre a Stellantis e a concessionária, disseminando e garantindo a aplicação das políticas comerciais
  • Acompanhar o mercado automotivo, identificando oportunidades e desenvolvendo estratégias comerciais

The Director Non-Clinical Due Diligence & External Evaluations providesscientific leadership for nonclinical due diligencesupporting CSL’s in‑licensing, acquisitions, and strategic collaborations. The role reports to the Executive Director, Head of Nonclinical Development.

Responsibilities and accountabilities

  • Integrate input from Toxicology, PK/QSP, Nonclinical Pharmacology, and external experts intoasingle, coherent scientific assessment.
  • IdentifyFIH‑enabling gaps, translational risks, and regulatory limitations, with clear mitigation proposals.
  • Prepare high‑quality DD reports, executive summaries, and risk tables for governance review.

  • Contribute to maintenance and continuous improvement of nonclinical DD frameworks and templates.
  • Mentor junior contributors and matrix team members as appropriate.
  • Escalates complex or high‑impact issues to Head of NCD
  • Chair of “NCD Review Committee”

Qualifications:

Education:

  • Advanced degree (Ph.D., D.V.M., or equivalent) in toxicology, pharmacology, or a related field
  • Toxicology training, board certification preferred

Experience :

  • Experience in nonclinical development (10+ years) with proven experience in due diligence or external innovation, ideally across various geographies.
  • Strong understanding of FIH‑enabling nonclinical requirements, particularly for biologics and complex modalities.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific risk clearly to non‑expert stakeholders.
  • Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.

Competencies:

  • Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.

  • Excellent communication and analytical skills.

  • Strong planning and organizational skills.

  • Strong negotiation skills and ability to identify and engage internal and external expertise as needed.
  • Good understanding of drug development process, strong knowledge of ICH/GLP
  • Fluent in English, oral and written;

The role requires onsite presence 3 days per week.

The role can be based in Zurich, Switzerland or Waltham, USA.

About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

Head Of Project Control Hanseatic Global Terminals Ribeira Do Piauí, Federative Republic Of Brazil, BR

About us

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is a fully owned subsidiary of Hapag-Lloyd. Operating from Rotterdam, HGT manages a portfolio of stakes in 26 marine terminals and complementary logistics services across 13 countries across 5 continents: Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Africa - with plans to expand its stakes to ~30 terminals by 2030.

Spanning key regions, its portfolio comprises port terminals and related logistics services operated by Hanseatic Global Terminals Latin America in Latin America and Florida (USA), and, in the booming Indian market, it is present through the container terminals, depots and rail business of J M Baxi, India's largest integrated terminal and logistics provider. Additionally, HGT's presence in strategic European hubs, such as Germany, France and the Mediterranean, enhances its global network and allows it to offer seamless, efficient logistics and supply chain solutions to customers worldwide.

At HGT, we are a highly motivated team of experienced international professionals who believe that growth in any partnership comes from trust and dedication. Our commitment to provide highly efficient terminal operations that are safe, sustainable, and reliable is rooted in a simple yet powerful vision: "offering exceptional service quality at all times."

The project: Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz port terminal:

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is embarking on an exciting new chapter with the development of Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz, a state–of–the–art container terminal created in partnership with the Imetame Group. Following HGT's recent agreement to acquire 50% of the shares in Imetame Logisíca Porto (ILP), this joint venture marks a significant strategic investment in Brazil's evolving port landscape and will play a key role in strengthening global supply chain connectivity.

Located in Aracruz, Espírito Santo, the new terminal is designed to be a modern transshipment and gateway hub for the region. Expected to launch operations by mid–2028, the facility will feature a capacity of approximately 1.2 million TEU, 750 meters of quay, advanced cargo‐handling technology, and 17 meters of water depth, enabling the efficient handling of the industry's largest vessels.

As HGT and the Imetame Group work together to build and operate this future‐ready terminal, we are assembling a team of talented professionals who will help shape the next major milestone in Brazil's port infrastructure development. The project represents an opportunity to be part of a transformational venture that will set new standards for performance, innovation, and operational excellence.

The position

The Head of Project Control is responsible for creating a clear and trusted view of project performance by ensuring accurate, timely, and transparent communication across internal teams and external stakeholders. This role brings project management excellence to the forefront by applying best practices, and tools, to support strong decision making and maintain focus on customer value as it evolves. At the same time, the Head of Project Controls cultivates a proactive, insight-driven project environment by using leading and lagging indicators to anticipate risks early, highlight improvement opportunities, and guide the project consistently toward successful outcomes.

Success requires transparency, deep expertise, and a forward‐looking mindset that continuously predicts, improves, and strengthens project performance.

Key Responsibilities

The Head of Project Controls is expected to perform the following responsibilities throughout the project:

General

  • Implement, maintain, and champion the transparent use of HGT project management and control tools across the project team, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Establish and maintain the project's scope, schedule, quality, and budget baselines.
  • Facilitate:
    • Effective application of core project governance processes, including (Change management, scope, schedule, requirements, and budget changes)
    • Risk management, ensuring timely input and ownership from the project team
    • Document Management and correspondence registration system
  • Monitor progress against approved baselines and ensure that deviations are identified early, addressed promptly, and escalated or reported when necessary
  • Ensure correct and timely project performance reporting:
    • within the project and team.
    • to Project Director and other relevant project leaders.
    • to Head Office.
    • to other corporate counterparts (as required).

Communication

  • Function as primary point of contact for all project control systems and be responsible for the user rights administration.
  • Liaise with the functional counterpart on project control system issues and improvements.
  • Hold regular touchpoints with construction, equipment, IT and finance teams to stay ahead of potential project control issues.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with head office counterparts, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.

Interfaces

  • Work closely with all project disciplines to ensure consistent, accurate, and coordinated project controls.
  • Liaise with relevant HGT global departments to maintain alignment with company standards and best practices.

Job requirements

  • Relevant professional experience: 10 years overall, including a minimum of 5 years within a project controls functional discipline.
  • Holding a bachelor's degree (or relevant).
  • Working in a cultural and technical diverse team and environment, internally and externally to your organization.
  • Confidently present and communicate with internal project teams and external HQ stakeholders in both written and spoken English and Portuguese.
  • Coach, mentor, and support others across the project team or wider functional areas.
  • Demonstrate relevant, practical technical experience and knowledge in project controls and project management disciplines.
  • Delivering a high-level of accuracy and quality.
  • Hold an advanced project management qualification, such as APM PMQ, PMI PMP, or an equivalent certification.
  • Proficient in project management platforms and systems used for document control, contract management, change control, cost management, communications, and milestone tracking (e.G., Aconex, PMWeb, PCM, Skire, or similar).
  • Skilled in project management and scheduling tools such as Primavera Cloud, Primavera P6, MS Project, or equivalent.
  • Experience supervising or line‐managing others in project controls or project management roles.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to shape the global footprint of a fast‐growing terminal operator.
  • High-impact leadership role in a dynamic, global, and collaborative organization.

description:
Descrição da vaga

About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Em 1986, Marcos Aurélio de Abreu Rodrigues e Silva, após dois anos à frente da ABRH-Nacional (gestão ), resolveu transformar suas convicções em resposta real ao mercado: Employer.

A primeira ideia foi transformar os desafios do agenciamento de trabalho temporário e da terceirização em garantia de qualidade para as empresas e em melhores oportunidades para os trabalhadores. Deu tão certo que a Employer se tornou uma das maiores empresas do setor, reconhecida por sua excelência em todo o Brasil.

A segunda ideia foi levar a eficiência da contratação profissional ao campo. Em 1997, a empresa de mão de obra rural da Employer surge para apoiar a expansão do agronegócio, com equipe qualificada. Foi nesta época também que deu-se origem a outra empresa do Grupo Employer para realizar gestão de benefícios, que chegou ao mercado para agregar todos os benefícios dos colaboradores em um só produto.

Em 1998, o próximo grande passo: dar o máximo de agilidade ao recrutamento e seleção para vagas de todos os tipos, do operacional ao gerencial. Nasceu o banco de currículos, que atualmente conta com mais de 20 milhões de currículos cadastrados, e que pode ser consultado por empresas a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar.

Pensando em simplificar os processos de contratação e administração de estagiários, a empresa criou em 2009 um serviço que funciona como agente de integração entre empresas e instituições de ensino.

E em sintonia com a inovação e com a mobilidade digital, a Employer foi mais longe. Lançou soluções em serviços de folha de pagamento online e holerite interativo na internet, desenvolvidas por uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas em RH e profissionais de TI.

Hoje, a Employer é uma das maiores empresas de RH do Brasil. Com mais de 40 filiais, atende às maiores companhias do País e do mundo que buscam soluções eficientes para este setor.

As ações não param por aí! A Employer continua inovando a cada dia para facilitar o cotidiano de seus clientes, colaboradores e parceiros.

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

  • Contribuir no monitoramento dos componentes dos sistemas (canais de captação, bombas, floculação, decantação, filtração, homogeneização, centrifugação, flotação etc.), auxiliando na verificação de possíveis trepidações, barulhos, a injeção de produtos químicos, e também, na limpeza dos equipamentos, visando possibilitar perfeito
  • funcionamento, com qualidade do produto final;
  • Auxiliar na limpeza e conservação dos sistemas, ajudando no manejo dos comandos de filtros de areia, manobras de válvulas, troca de elementos filtrantes, auxiliando nos processos de retro lavagens, limpezas manuais e outros mecanismos, para retirada de impurezas e manutenção de indicadores do sistema de tratamento da água;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento da qualidade da água, em etapas do processo, retirando amostras, auxiliando nas análises de condutividade, turbidez, cloro etc. e alterações de dosagens de produtos, de forma a obter a qualidade esperada;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento da qualidade da água, no final do processo, confrontando com os parâmetros estabelecidos e o monitoramento dos fluxos e dos ajustes cabíveis, visando maximizar produção com a qualidade esperada;
  • Contribuir na realização de análises laboratoriais, nas diferentes fases do processo de tratamento da água, fazendo uso de alguns instrumentos de medição e precisão, anotando alguns resultados, para fins de controle e/ou auditorias;
  • Auxiliar no controle de vazões, ph, Oxigênio Dissolvido (OS) para decantação do lodo (efluente), retirando amostras, auxiliando nas anotações e informando eventuais alterações de parâmetros dos produtos químicos utilizados no tratamento dos efluentes;
  • Auxiliar na retirada do lodo (efluentes), na centrífuga, manejando bomba, auxiliando no adicionamento de produtos químicos, a fim de manter a concentração dos microorganismos;
  • Auxiliar na operação do flotador, adicionando produtos químicos, manejando bomba, de modo a possibilitar transferência dos resíduos (efluentes), com a qualidade exigida nas normas ambientais.

Postos de Trabalho: Incineração e Coprocessamento

  • Auxiliar na realização do checklist do processo de incineração, verificando tipos e códigos dos resíduos, tanques de destinação, horários etc., atentando para o passo-a-passo do procedimento, ajustando e atentando para os indicadores de painéis, fazendo anotações, leituras óticas, de forma a dar início às operações de resíduos líquidos;
  • Auxiliar na operação de equipamentos do sistema de incineração, tais como, bombas pneumáticas, elétricas, compressores etc., acionando botões, manejando válvulas, valendo-se das liberações das análises laboratoriais e das especificações dos resíduos e procedendo segundo orientação recebida, visando aos procedimentos de transferências
  • ou operações do Incinerador;
  • Auxiliar no manejo de válvulas do incinerador, regulando quantidades determinadas para os queimadores, atentando para o desempenho de todo o processo: possibilidades de vazamentos, travamentos, explosões, acidentes, danos ambientais ou reações químicas, de modo a garantir operação e produção nos padrões visados;
  • Manipular bombonas, tonéis e demais embalagens de resíduos sólidos mediante empilhadeira, fazendo leitura ótica, colocando-os em elevadores apropriados, acionando botões, acompanhando o fluxo do processo e os indicadores dos painéis de controle (temperatura, oxigênio), visando certificar-se do andamento da operação, nos padrões esperados;
  • Manter constantes monitoramentos do forno, à luz do visor, atentando para eventuais obstruções, travamentos, verificando o fluxo dos resíduos, entre outros cuidados necessários;
  • Auxiliar na operação dos sistemas agregados ao Incinerador, tais como: transferências de líquidos, prensagem e calcinação de tambores, lavagens de gases, manobras dos instrumentos etc., preparando cargas, operando bombas pneumáticas, acionando válvulas, fazendo alinhamentos para direcionamentos de resíduos, montagens e desmontagens, retirando lanças, auxiliando as equipes de manutenção, quando necessário, visando atender às necessidades complementares do sistema;
  • Fazer anotações diversas, procedendo segundo orientação ou procedimento determinado, visando ao controle das operações.

Atividades comuns a qualquer posto de trabalho:

  • Acompanhar fornecedores, informando e verificando processos operacionais, para validar sistemas a serem implantados;
  • Participar das operações de emergência, procedendo a aumentos de pressão ou alterações de procedimentos, realizando testes e simulações, de forma a remediar imediatamente o problema e assegurar-se do restabelecimento total do processo operacional;
  • Manter-se atento a atos ou condições inseguras de trabalho, nas equipes internas ou terceirizadas, informando e/ou tomando providências preventivas, segundo as instruções institucionais recebidas;
  • Manter interfaces operacionais com clientes, buscando suas necessidades ou níveis de satisfação, para nortear a alimentação e operação do sistema;
  • Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e complexidade, a critério de seu superior.
  • Cumprir políticas, procedimentos e padrões estabelecidos pelo sistema de gestão específico, utilizando equipamentos preventivos, observando normas e procedimentos regulamentares, reportando desvios e propondo correções de atos inseguros, de modo a contribuir para a implementação e manutenção dos preceitos normativos, legais e atos que regem o SGI;
  • Participar dos eventos internos / campanhas / treinamentos ligados ao SGI.
